release.name: v2.0.1
release.body:
## [2.0.1](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1) (2026-11-05)


### Bug Fixes

* **build:** retain topology test harness for package mode ([4f0608b](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/4f0608b5f40ff51fc98657469a8d50d6cbbfa31f))
* **ci:** accept NuGet empty asset placeholders ([230a2d7](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/230a2d712cc00b9587e897c1a44c66dea061695d))
* **ci:** align approved workflow pins with Builds ([f24266b](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/f24266b628a2abcfbdc9f0d064e0e4c324d8e7c8))
* **ci:** align Builds revision with shared workflows ([01394f3](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/01394f3e48901268f236cf1d8054272416a0cc93))
* **ci:** align Builds workflow pins with gitlink ([88cc300](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/88cc300cb9f0b1ac98b0aaadc2a083126ba07366))
* **ci:** allow root submodule checkout to finish ([491d0f9](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/491d0f975baff6449225f70a322aa9b73c592cbc))
* **ci:** enable long paths before Windows checkout ([8a3467b](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/8a3467b10d24819efa6b7f99b3111a74a37bb365))
* **ci:** enforce native audit warnings as errors ([d92a5f1](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/d92a5f1ec4ec635627749470b179422e5342f351))
* **ci:** keep native catalog reader independent of advisory feed ([9185ffa](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/9185ffa826c339c056c4100bd2a839469d83cc6d))
* **ci:** pin commitlint workflow to current Builds catalog ([fb973d8](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/fb973d8663b7db51676668908d549f478621de62))
* **ci:** preserve compiler policy in native rebuilds ([5d5dd5f](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/5d5dd5fdf0007d273fa9044c6e1725d6490a42dd))
* **ci:** provide smoke writer bootstrap evidence path ([add6e20](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/add6e2079a2446fc764f95b4add87d49cda430a8))
* **ci:** use corrected shared Dapr initialization ([2322e27](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/2322e2736024ef5f3aeb807d820e84b2a8f7acab))
* **deps:** align Redis with EventStore 4.0.4 ([bf7d057](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/bf7d05721733d699381fb971b55f89193991cf0d))
* **deps:** qualify the public SDK 4.1 cohort ([624de50](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/624de50385ac3d9aab15f25d056f1f24ae651645))
* **release:** select a fresh pair after the bootstrap ([edaecb0](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/edaecb04b1a8edf78f6ad28e5bf253db594003f4))
* **runtime:** bind native requests to audited catalog authority ([bd2f8ee](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/bd2f8eef97d32063c05fc200f706a7db00e4a71a))
* **runtime:** preserve declared query selector wire fields ([2e80701](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/2e80701c31aafdf00abee05ac469a45ed76dfdf5))
* story 4.18 ([7a4e4dc](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/7a4e4dcbd3ebb3cfc90b11fa3dcea1233283b397))
* submodules ([6b39784](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/6b39784e71303b54fcf4842c2715c0c47d0e06cc))
* **topology:** accept gateway readback without owner executable digest ([4ef67f6](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/4ef67f67031663bb18d6e4be09709336e41c320e))
* **topology:** align qualified source hosts with Redis floor ([5c1a200](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/5c1a20082fe3c4bc1c7630191f8bf35ceda6a438))
* **topology:** align Tenants and Builds with EventStore 4.0.4 ([8a5975b](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/8a5975b3121b6ae6e5204cf0a6c5f3709358a3e5))
* **topology:** carry pinned catalog through Aspire rebuilds ([7c3b751](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/7c3b7514e5f56d19bf0dd796cea84080640fa5c3))
* **topology:** prepare Tenants from unsuppressed source project ([700752f](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/700752fc85f205cf7644a42b6f1d7ed60db1d9e1))
* **topology:** qualify canonical EventStore and Tenants runtime ([bdea9dc](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/bdea9dc808cb12c06a2db69d71165026d3454f43))
* **topology:** refuse nested catalogs during source selection ([4f6c3d6](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/4f6c3d6cc7f7fc6053072d086d55bcfda5b937e3))
* **topology:** retain verified native preparation evidence ([a6cdb6e](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/a6cdb6e84894e3ab455cce8d0c5c6539ac8769fa))
* **topology:** select Development for native catalog tests ([0e6129e](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/0e6129e5bf08611cb01b2dffbf3eaaf1f728c25f))
* **topology:** verify adapter archives without copy-local DLLs ([b052732](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.McpCli/commit/b052732dd9f0fd3a973602a52f854550edf5f802))
